# Semrush UI/UX Clone

> A UI/UX study clone for prototyping. Not affiliated with Semrush. Content is representative/placeholder.

## Pages
- /features/ : feature catalog
- /solutions/ : solutions by use case, size, role, industry
- /pricing/ : plans and pricing
- /free-tools/ : free marketing tools
- /blog/ , /kb/ , /academy/ : resources

## Notes
- This project reproduces layout, components, and interaction patterns for learning purposes.
- Marketing copy, brand names, and data shown are placeholders, not the original site's content.
